description: Draft a reply to one comment from list_comments_to_answer and store it; nothing is posted. Pass `text` to use the user's own wording (no cost), or omit it and nooticr writes one in the brand voice (costs 1 nooticr credit) and says why in `rationale`; `guidance` steers the writing and `appId` names the product when the workspace has several. A written reply is refused, free, when there is no brand voice, no product and no guidance to write it from. Replies may not contain links, emails, phone numbers or @-mentions of anyone but the commenter. Returns a draftId and a confirmationToken: show the reply to the user first, then post it with post_comment_reply. For several comments on one account, pass commentIds (up to 10) in place of commentId and postId: each gets its own written reply, at 1 nooticr credit per reply drafted, and the answer lists `drafts`, each with its own draftId and confirmationToken, and the `skipped` comments with why; text cannot be used then, and a postId given then must be the post every comment is on. Use when the user wants to answer one comment from list_comments_to_answer, or several.

account.description: Connection id (`connectionId` from list_social_connections) when the profile has more than one account on the platform.

appId.description: Product id whose brand a written reply speaks for, when the workspace has more than one. Omitted, the only product is used, or none.

commentId.description: Comment id from list_comments_to_answer. Required with postId unless commentIds is given.

commentIds.description: In place of commentId: up to 10 comment ids from list_comments_to_answer, each answered with its own written reply (1 credit per reply drafted). text cannot be used with it.

guidance.description: What the reply should say or avoid; a URL here is the only URL the reply may contain.

influencerId.description: Creator profile id when more than one account is connected.

platform.description: The network the comment is on.

postId.description: Post id the comment is on. Required with commentId; with commentIds, optional, and every comment must be on it.

text.description: The reply to store, in the user's words. Omit to have one written (1 credit).

name: draft_comment_reply

confirmationToken.description: Pass to post_comment_reply with confirm: true after the user agrees.

drafts.description: commentIds only: one stored draft per comment answered, each shown to the user and posted on its own.

rationale.description: Why a written reply says what it says; absent when the user gave the text.

reply.description: The stored reply text. Show it to the user before posting.

skipped.description: commentIds only: the comments not drafted, with why. None of them was charged.

title: Draft Comment Reply
